dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

This record covers single maps of Maine showing postal routes, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
